topArticle.title: Wednesday briefing: ​How misinformation and ​a​ hardened immigration policy ​turned Ceuta ​into Europe’s ​latest ​flashpoint
topArticle.description:
In today’s newsletter: The past week shows how quickly images, rumours and ​right-wing political opportunism can eclipse the facts on the ground
Good morning. Last week, an estimated 72,000 migrants began crossing into a tiny Spanish enclave on the tip of Morocco. Within 24 hours, most of them had headed home. At least 88 people died after attempting the crossing, according to local officials. This isn’t the whole story of what happened over the last week, but the facts are worth remembering.
At an emergency meeting yesterday, EU interior ministers sought to draw a line under Ceuta, insisting that the passport-free Schengen area had never been at risk from the arrival of migrants at this scale. Despite this, much of the media coverage has suggested that events in Ceuta represent a territorial threat to Europe, sparking calls for greater security across the region’s borders.
Environment | Eight of the biggest oil companies amassed profits of more than $90bn (£67bn) in just three months as the Iran conflict sent energy prices soaring and the emissions-fuelled climate crisis caused deadly heatwaves.
UK politics | Women should not feel pressurised into experiencing an “ideal birth”, the new health secretary, Yvette Cooper, has said, promising a root-and-branch reform of standards after several damning maternity scandals.
Middle East | Jordan is convening an emergency meeting over an “imminent” threat of an Israeli takeover of the most important Muslim site in Jerusalem, with the potential to “trigger a religious conflict”.
Ukraine | Russian strikes in and around Kyiv killed at least 14 people, ⁠injured 27 and ⁠damaged warehouses, ​emergency service officials said. Some reports put the death toll at 15.
Ceuta | Hundreds of people have gathered in the northern Moroccan town of Fnideq, near the border with Spain’s Ceuta, flashing photos of their missing loved ones to passersby in the hope of tracking them down.
 Continue reading...

The president of the European Commission has called for action to strengthen Europe’s borders after tens of thousands of people arrived and quickly left the Spanish territory of Ceuta, triggering a furious row between Madrid and other European countries.
In a letter to Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, on Monday, Ursula von der Leyen said: “From this incident, it is clear that we must do more to further strengthen our borders at critical points, including vigilant monitoring and the use of physical barriers where needed.”

topArticle.description: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.
topArticle.titleJa: ギリシャで消火ヘリコプターが衝突し乗員2名死亡、英国人パイロットは生存
topArticle.summary: ギリシャで消火活動中のヘリコプターが衝突事故を起こし、デンマーク人とギリシャ人の乗員2名が死亡した。英国人パイロットら2名は生存。

topArticle.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
topArticle.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
topArticle.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルにおける警察暴力支持への異議申し立てに貢献した方法
topArticle.summary: ブラジルで、AI研究ツールが警察暴力に対する大規模な国民の支持に異議を唱えるのに貢献した。2023年には高い暴力死率を記録。

topArticle.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
topArticle.description: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.
topArticle.titleJa: ニカラグアの指導者、大統領任期をさらに1年延長することを提案
topArticle.summary: ダニエル・オルテガ大統領（80歳）が長期政権を維持するために憲法が改正されるのは、今回が初めてではない。

topArticle.title: On the front line of Ecuador's drugs war, police fight gangs, guns and corruption
topArticle.description: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルの麻薬戦争最前線、警察はギャング、銃、汚職と戦う
topArticle.summary: エクアドルの警察は麻薬犯罪の急増に直面しており、ギャングや汚職と戦う彼らの最前線にBBCが密着した。

topArticle.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
topArticle.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
topArticle.titleJa: 地震後のベネズエラの復興にはどれくらいの費用がかかるのか？
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの地震被害の初期推定は、復興には前例のない財源と長期的な経済回復努力が必要であることを示唆している。

topArticle.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
topArticle.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
topArticle.titleJa: 70年後、アルゼンチンの裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と認定
topArticle.summary: 70年を経て、アルゼンチンの裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と認定。犠牲者の家族は法廷で証言し、真実と正義を求めた。

topArticle.title: 'I feel like I dug my own grave': The workers caught in the AI transition
topArticle.description: AI is reshaping the Philippines' outsourcing industry, raising questions over the future of the industry.
topArticle.titleJa: 「自ら墓穴を掘った気分」：AI移行に巻き込まれる労働者たち
topArticle.summary: AIがフィリピンのアウトソーシング産業を再構築しており、多くの労働者が職を失う不安を抱え、業界の将来に疑問を投げかけている。

topArticle.title: Jetstar introduces fees for carry-on luggage in overhead lockers
topArticle.description: Many Australians are outraged while others say it's 'about time' passengers are charged for larger bags.
topArticle.titleJa: ジェットスター、頭上の手荷物棚使用に料金導入
topArticle.summary: ジェットスター航空が機内持ち込み手荷物の頭上ロッカー使用に料金を導入。多くのオーストラリア人が反発する一方、当然だと受け止める声も。

topArticle.title: Moment pilot caught with 70,000 ecstasy pills at Indonesian airport
topArticle.description: A Malaysian pilot was arrested at Jakarta airport after being found with around four stone (26kg) of drugs hidden in his luggage.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシアの空港でパイロットが7万錠のエクスタシー所持で逮捕された瞬間
topArticle.summary: インドネシアのジャカルタ空港で、マレーシア人パイロットが約26kgのエクスタシーを隠し持っていたとして逮捕された。

topArticle.title: Massive Attack respond after Singapore ban over Palestine display
topArticle.description: The UK band says they are "surprised and disappointed" by their treatment over shouting "free Palestine" at a concert there.
topArticle.titleJa: パレスチナ支持表明でシンガポールから締め出し後、マッシヴ・アタックが反応
topArticle.summary: UKのバンド、マッシヴ・アタックがシンガポール公演での「パレスチナ解放」叫びで受けた処遇に「驚きと失望」を表明した。

topArticle.title: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first confirmed outside contact for 2.5 years
topArticle.description: Photos newly released by Myanmar's military government show Suu Kyi meeting with an ICRC official.
topArticle.titleJa: アウンサンスーチー氏、2年半ぶりの外部との接触で健康な姿
topArticle.summary: ミャンマーの軍事政権が公開した写真で、アウンサンスーチー氏がICRC関係者と面会し、健康な様子が2年半ぶりに確認された。

topArticle.title: Malaysian boy on trial for allegedly murdering girl in school
topArticle.description: The high-profile case has shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about the effect of social media on children.
topArticle.titleJa: マレーシアの少年、学校で少女殺害の疑いで裁判に
topArticle.summary: マレーシアで少年が学校で少女を殺害した疑いで裁判にかけられており、この注目度の高い事件は国内に衝撃を与え、子供へのSNSの影響について議論を呼んでいる。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国およびLDCの貿易スキル向上を支援するため3万ユーロを寄付
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、途上国や後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上を支援するため、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを寄付。多角的貿易システムへの効果的な参加を促進する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年のWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンはWTO加盟作業部会で、2026年までの加盟完了目標を再確認。交渉責任者は、成功には関与の維持と懸念事項への対処が重要と強調した。
